Mr. Mehul Jadavji Shah was appointed as the Managing Director of the Company for a period of five years with effect from 15th January, 2020, pursuant to the approval of the members at the Annual General Meeting held on 30th September, 2020, without remuneration. Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 13th August, 2025, had approved and recommended to the members the re-appointment of Mr. Mehul Jadavji Shah as Managing Director of the Company for a further period of five consecutive years with effect from 13th August, 2025 to 12th August, 2030, without remuneration and liable to retire by rotation, subject to the approval of the members. The aforesaid resolution was placed before the members at the Annual General Meeting of the Company held on 30th September, 2025. However, the resolution did not receive the requisite majority and, accordingly, the proposed re-appointment of Mr. Mehul Jadavji Shah as Managing Director was not approved by the members.
Mr. Sanjay Shah (DIN: 00292226), retires by rotation and being eligible offers himself for re-appointment at the ensuing annual general meeting.

Mr. Hitesh Popatlal Sangoi (DIN: 00507189) re-appointed as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company for a second term of five consecutive years, commencing from the conclusion of this Annual General Meeting up to the conclusion of the 83rd Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held in the calendar year 2031, not liable to retire by rotation.

risks: The Collector, Mumbai has raised demand notice dated September 22, 2022 for transfer of the user from industrial purpose to commercial and residential purpose in regard to the Company's land. The total amount payable for the change of user is Rs. 44,59,26,500/-. Out of which the Company has already paid Rs. 9,40,29,060/- and the balance outstanding payment is Rs. 35,18,97,440/- payable along with interest. If unpaid, the said amount would be recovered through the compulsory remedy scheme as per Maharashtra Land Revenue Act 1996. As a part of recovery action, the collector has already attached some of the properties of the Company and Company's current bank account.

litigation: The Collector, Mumbai has raised demand notice dated September 22, 2022 for transfer of the user from industrial purpose to commercial and residential purpose in regard to the Company's land. The total amount payable for the change of user is Rs. 44,59,26,500/-. Out of which the Company has already paid Rs. 9,40,29,060/- and the balance outstanding payment is Rs. 35,18,97,440/- payable along with interest. If unpaid, the said amount would be recovered through the compulsory remedy scheme as per Maharashtra Land Revenue Act 1996. As a part of recovery action, the collector has already attached some of the properties of the Company and Company's current bank account.

Mr. Sanjay Damji Shah and Ms. Heena Sanjay Shah, shareholders of Shah Construction Company Limited, have filed Commercial Suit No. 12 of 2026 before the Hon'ble Bombay High Court against, inter alia, the Company, its directors, other promoter shareholders and Sheth Homes Private Limited, seeking, inter alia, setting aside of the Development Management Agreement dated September 30, 2025 executed between the Company and Sheth Homes Private Limited. By Order dated October 14, 2025, the Hon'ble Bombay High Court temporarily stayed implementation of the Development Management Agreement. The Company (Defendant No. 1), Mr. Mehul Jadavji Shah (Defendant No. 2) and Sheth Homes Private Limited (Defendant No. 12) have separately challenged the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble Bombay High Court to entertain the suit. The applications are part-heard and are pending final hearing on August 10, 2026.
